findings.location: Proof step 6.1, the inference that dim_K(H/J(H)) = Σ_λ f^λ² and hence J(H)=0 and the direct sum of cell modules is faithful.
findings.evidence: The preceding steps establish nondegenerate cell forms and a complete list of pairwise distinct absolutely simple cell modules, but the declared dependencies do not establish the semisimple-quotient dimension formula. Closing it requires the finite-dimensional Jacobson-radical quotient and Wedderburn–Artin decomposition, with absolute simplicity identifying each division endomorphism ring with K. The repository has these results in thm-jacobson-radical-is-nilpotent-and-the-quotient-is-semisimple and thm-wedderburn-artin-theorem, but this published item does not cite or depend on them. The assigned consumer uses the resulting faithfulness in Facts F2 and proof step 1.1.
